environment.description: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API) with Lambda proxy integration. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS Aurora cluster. DB_USER is provisioned via terraform-aws-rds-iam module with pg_hba.conf entry mapping to role 'lambda_ro_7f3a'. The role was created with: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO lambda_ro_7f3a; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO lambda_ro_7f3a; No additional grants exist. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and pgaudit.log='write' for compliance monitoring. CloudWatch subscription filter forwards pg audit logs to SecurityHub.

config.db_grants: SELECT ONLY on all tables in public schema
config.db_role_definition: CREATE ROLE lambda_ro_7f3a LOGIN; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO lambda_ro_7f3a;
